expected_value_creation: Users can audit whether stated confidence corresponds to later outcomes without confusing a calibration statistic with quality itself.
beneficiary: human reviewers, AI agents, governance owners, and organizations using QIF across domains
supporting_evidence: Existing quality-gate packages already retain confidence and post-release reviews.
Current evaluation guidance emphasizes real outcomes, validity checks, and explicit uncertainty boundaries.
success_criteria: Brier score and calibration buckets are reproduced from declared pairs and policy.
Insufficient, synthetic, example-only, stale, or misleading reports cannot claim empirical calibration and route to governance.
